messages:
maria: FYI found a public gist with a copy of a service account JSON. appears to be a staging SA that's also used by 3 internal services. I disabled the key in GCP console already but want a coordinated cleanup so we don't miss backups or long-lived tokens.

aj: can you drop the link (redact) and the SA email? also did you check if any of those services use KMS-wrapped blobs?

maria: gist: https://gist.github.com/[redacted], sa: staging-ingest@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com. looks like a full key file. I grep'd our backups and saw an old tar with the file. uncertain if any vault snapshots include it.

kevin: :eyes: I'll take KMS + backup side. planning: 1) rewrap any KMS blobs that reference that SA's keyring (if found), 2) rotate keys and re-encrypt backups, 3) purge stale stacks. ETA 2hrs.

nina: I'll handle Vault. We need to check if the SA json was ever stored as a plaintext secret or sealed secret. If so, we should rotate the Vault encryption key and revoke leases.

security-rotations: Proposed checklist (high-level):
1) Confirm and disable exposed key (done by maria).
2) Identify blast radius: services, backups, CI jobs, 3rd-party integrations.
3) Rotate the SA and create scoped alternatives for each service.
4) Update Vault roles/policies to avoid storing raw key files; replace with short-lived impersonation tokens.
5) Rewrap/rekey KMS artifacts and purge old ciphertexts.
6) Force rebind of any cached credentials (KV cache flush for runtime).
7) Audit logs: run queries for token use since leak time + monitor for suspicious activity.
8) Post-incident rotation summary and remediation tickets.

aj: For audit queries, use this to search bigquery logs:
```
SELECT protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail, timestamp, protoPayload.requestMetadata.callerIp
FROM `redwood-logs.cloudaudit_googleapis_com_activity_*
WHERE resource.labels.service = "iam.googleapis.com" AND protoPayload.request.@type LIKE "%GenerateAccessToken%" AND timestamp > "2025-06-01T00:00:00Z"
```
We should also grep object store access logs for the SA principal.

maria: I've kicked off a backup scan for files containing the service account email. found two tar blobs in s3-staging-archives/2025-05. kevin, can you prioritize those for re-encryption and then deletion?

kevin: Copy. Starting re-encrypt of s3-staging-archives/2025-05/ingest-backup.tar.gz -> will create new ciphertext with customer-kms-prod/key-2 and then delete old. I'll push a short runbook command in the thread when done.

devops-bot: job=rotate-s3-cipher started by=kevin job_id=rot-2190-01 ts=2025-06-11T14:12:10Z

nina: For Vault: checklist I will run:
- vault kv metadata get secret/staging/ingest || true
- vault list secret/staging || true
- revoke-orphaned leases via: vault lease revoke -prefix secret/staging/ingest
Then update roles to use iam impersonation.

aj: I'll also request an RBAC audit in GCP: list all principals with iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator on that SA and remove any unnecessary ones. We should have a temporary deny for broad groups while we triage (:no_entry_sign:).

maria: quick Q — do we need to rekey Vault master key (transit) or just rotate secrets? My vote: rotate secrets + revoke leases now; consider rekey/transit rewrap only if we detect persisted plaintext or unauthorized access.

kevin: agree with Maria. Rekeying Vault master is heavy and will take more time; do as follow-up if logs show misuse beyond expected. For KMS rewrap we'll create new key version and rotate ciphertexts.

security-rotations: Additional remediation notes: make sure we update the Redwood Console secrets inventory and set alerts: secret.exposed==true -> create high-priority ticket and auto-expire old snapshots older than 90d.

aj: Assignments: maria=investigate scope & SIEM, kevin=KMS/backups, nina=Vault & secrets inventory, aj=logs + RBAC cleanup.

maria: I'll open a postmortem stub and record timeline. tagging @ops oncall in case we need rapid rollbacks.

kevin: re-encrypt pass done for first tar. pushed runbook snippet:
```
aws s3 cp s3://s3-staging-archives/2025-05/ingest-backup.tar.gz - | gcloud kms encrypt --location=global --keyring=customer-kms-prod --key=key-2 --plaintext-file=- --ciphertext-file=- | aws s3 cp - s3://s3-staging-archives/2025-05/ingest-backup.tar.gz.enc
```
I'll delete the old object after verifying checksum. :white_check_mark:

devops-bot: job=rotate-s3-cipher completed job_id=rot-2190-01 status=success ts=2025-06-11T15:03:02Z

aj: Audit query results so far: no external IP usage detected, a few CI jobs in the window used the SA (we will rotate those). Adding a watch for unusual grants.

nina: Vault leases revoked for secret/staging/ingest, replaced with short-lived impersonation role. Updated policy to forbid storing SA keyfiles in kv.

maria: thanks all. next steps: finish sweep of backups, confirm RBAC reduction, publish short postmortem and lessons. :thumbsup:
